description: This file defines a web scraper class 'CarriesExperimentalKitchen' for extracting recipe information from the website carriesexperimentalkitchen.com. It includes methods to retrieve equipment needed, ingredient groups, and ingredients, utilizing HTML parsing with BeautifulSoup.

classes.name: CarriesExperimentalKitchen
classes.description: A scraper class for carriesexperimentalkitchen.com, inheriting from AbstractScraper, with methods to extract equipment, ingredient groups, and ingredients.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the hostname of the target website.

methods.name: equipment
methods.description: Extracts and returns a list of equipment needed for the recipe.

methods.name: ingredient_groups
methods.description: Returns a list of IngredientGroup objects representing grouped ingredients, excluding equipment.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Extracts and returns a flat list of ingredients from the recipe.
